rows.en: Yeah, you'd never think we're in the middle of space.

I wore my swimsuit under my clothes, so I could
just change behind a tree or something...
We both came prepared!

Okay, we're both changed,
so let's have all the fun we can!

(I lost all track of time playing...
But it was so much fun~)

(All right, it's the artificial island
with Nanase again today!)
rows.notes: Source ends with a newline plus a full-width space (an empty second line); dropped, the English breaks naturally.

rows.en:
Okay, \p-kun,
shall we head right out?
Oh, you're all fired up again today.
Huh?! I-I'm not...
Haah~ The sea really does feel great!

Yeah. It's weird to have a sea out
in the middle of space, though...

It is. But when you look at it like this,
it really looks just like the real thing!

You said it!
Well, let's play a little longer!
(Man, I really played my heart out!)

(All right, it's the artificial island
with Nanase again today!)

rows.en:
Okay, \p-san,
shall we head right out?
Oh, looks like you're all fired up again today.

Yeah. It's weird to have a sea out
in the middle of space, though...

You said it!
Okay, let's play a little longer!
(Phew~ I really played my heart out!)

(Class is over, so maybe I'll peek
into the art room.)

Oh, \p-kun.
I was just about to take a break.
Would you like to join me?
Well then, I'll gladly take you up on it.

Phew~ The Chinese tea you make really is
delicious, Nanase.
Huh? But I made black tea today...?
Huh? Really? Man, that's embarrassing...
Hee hee, I'm just kidding.
You got me...
But it's rare for you to crack a joke, Nanase.
Huh? It's not that rare... I think...
Well, it's not like there's anything weird about it.
...If it is rare...

If it is rare,
maybe it's because it's you.
Huh? What do you mean?

Well, it's like I can talk to you without feeling
self-conscious... Like I can just talk naturally...
I see.

Of course, I can talk normally with
Saotome-kun and Michel-kun too, but...
Hmm~ Is that so?
Because it's you...

Oh, no, it's nothing.
Come on, drink your tea before it gets cold!

Okay then, let me try that again.
Thanks for the tea!
(I wonder what Nanase was going to say?)

(Class is over, so I'll go peek
into the art room.)

Oh, \p-san.
I was just about to take a break.
Would you like to join me?
Sure, I'll gladly have some~

Phew~ The Chinese tea you make really is
delicious, Nanase.
Huh? It's not? That's weird...
Geez...

But it's kind of rare for you to crack a joke,
Nanase.
Well, it's not like there's anything weird about it.

Like, you're easy to talk to,
or, how do I put it...
Hmm~

Of course, I can talk normally with Ranka-san
and the kids in the art department too,
but this feels a little different.

Okay then, let me try that again.
Thanks for the tea~
(I wonder what Nanase was trying to say?)

Oh, \p-kun.
Welcome! I'll make some more tea.

Thanks.
Sorry, it's like I came here asking for it.

Huh? You mean you didn't?
Just kidding.

Phew.
Your tea really is delicious, Nanase.
Honestly, tea is all I can offer, you know.
That's too bad.

(Spending time with Nanase in the art room
is so relaxing.)

Oh, \p-san.
Welcome! I'll make some more tea.

Thanks.
Sorry, it's like I came here asking for it.

Haah.
Your tea really is delicious, Nanase.
That's too bad.

uncertain: c11825/c11826: dato shitara read as 'if it really is rare (that I joke)', picking up the player's remark two rows earlier; rendered 'If it is rare...'.
c11840 (female): the player answers Nanase's 'I made black tea today' with 'Huh? It's not? That's weird...' (Japanese 'are? sou? okashii naa'), matching the male 'Really? Man, that's embarrassing'.
c11846: bijutsuka rendered as 'the kids in the art department' (not the glossary Art Course term geijutsuka, which is a different word).
c11799/c11808: the source's trailing empty line (newline + full-width space) was dropped.
